description: This file defines the VoiceSessionCoordinator class, which manages voice recognition sessions including starting, updating, finalizing, and dismissing sessions, as well as interfacing with overlay UI and forwarding voice data.

classes.name: VoiceSessionCoordinator
classes.description: A final class that manages voice recognition sessions, including starting, updating, finalizing, and dismissing sessions, and coordinating with UI overlays and forwarding services.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new voice session with specified source, text, and optional attributed text, returning a UUID token.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the current session with partial transcript text and attributed text.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes a session with the provided text, send chime, and optional auto-send delay.

methods.name: sendNow
methods.description: Triggers immediate sending of the current session's transcript.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the current session with specified reason and outcome.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the audio level indicator for the current session.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current session's token, text, and visibility status.

methods.name: overlayDidDismiss
methods.description: Handles actions when the overlay is dismissed, ensuring session cleanup and UI state refresh.
